policy: Retain every baseline C feature and category string. Add all calculable value-only extension features; no D feature selection, names/labels/row context/hidden truncation.
representative_policy: Up to3 whole values: most frequent/lexical tie; seeded uniform distinct; maximally lexically different. >80-char values omitted only from additional representatives, counted explicitly; baseline C top categories remain uncut.
decision_policy: Same SYSTEM/output schema/common policy as frozen C. No confidence percentage or name exception. Partial parsing does not prove semantic equivalence, business units or date granularity.
promotion_gate: Do not deploy automatically. Candidate must improve planned-denominator Top1 strictly, with no reduction in matched precision or matched coverage. Even a pass is descriptive, not commercial certification.
